"use client";

import { AlertCircleIcon, NoteEditIcon } from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import type { IconSvgElement } from "@hugeicons/react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import {
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useLayoutEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  useSyncExternalStore,
} from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, FormEvent } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type GenerativeFormFieldType =
  | "text"
  | "longtext"
  | "number"
  | "boolean"
  | "select"
  | "date";

export interface GenerativeFormOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface GenerativeFormField {
  /** Key in the object. Dots reach into nested objects: `customer.name`. */
  name: string;
  /** Defaults to the name in plain words. */
  label?: string;
  /** Defaults to what the value looks like, then `text`. */
  type?: GenerativeFormFieldType;
  /** Choices for a `select` field. */
  options?: readonly (string | GenerativeFormOption)[];
  required?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Shown before the value, such as `$`. */
  prefix?: string;
}

export type GenerativeFormValue = string | number | boolean;

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

const isValue = (value: unknown): value is GenerativeFormValue =>
  typeof value === "string" ||
  typeof value === "boolean" ||
  (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value));

/** `dueDate`, `due_date`, and `customer.dueDate` all read as `Due date`. */
export const fieldLabel = (name: string): string => {
  const words = (name.split(".").at(-1) ?? name)
    .replaceAll(/[_-]+/gu, " ")
    .replaceAll(/([a-z\d])([A-Z])/gu, "$1 $2")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  return words ? `${words.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${words.slice(1)}` : name;
};

const readPath = (source: unknown, path: string): unknown => {
  let current = source;
  for (const key of path.split(".")) {
    if (!isRecord(current)) {
      return undefined;
    }
    current = current[key];
  }
  return current;
};

const writePath = (
  target: Record<string, unknown>,
  path: string,
  value: unknown
) => {
  const keys = path.split(".");
  let current = target;
  for (const key of keys.slice(0, -1)) {
    const next = current[key];
    if (isRecord(next)) {
      current = next;
    } else {
      const created: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      current[key] = created;
      current = created;
    }
  }
  current[keys.at(-1) ?? path] = value;
};

const LONG_TEXT = 72;

const typeOfValue = (value: GenerativeFormValue): GenerativeFormFieldType => {
  if (typeof value === "boolean") {
    return "boolean";
  }
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return "number";
  }
  return value.length > LONG_TEXT || value.includes("\n") ? "longtext" : "text";
};

/**
 * Fields read off the object itself, in the order its keys arrive. Nested
 * objects become dotted names. Arrays are left out.
 */
export const generativeFormFields = (
  object: unknown,
  prefix = ""
): GenerativeFormField[] => {
  if (!isRecord(object)) {
    return [];
  }
  return Object.entries(object).flatMap(([key, value]) => {
    const name = `${prefix}${key}`;
    if (isRecord(value)) {
      return generativeFormFields(value, `${name}.`);
    }
    return isValue(value) ? [{ name, type: typeOfValue(value) }] : [];
  });
};

const schemaType = (property: Record<string, unknown>) => {
  const { type } = property;
  return Array.isArray(type) ? type.find((item) => item !== "null") : type;
};

const schemaField = (
  name: string,
  property: Record<string, unknown>,
  required: boolean
): GenerativeFormField | null => {
  const base = {
    label: typeof property.title === "string" ? property.title : undefined,
    name,
    required,
  };
  const type = schemaType(property);
  if (Array.isArray(property.enum)) {
    return { ...base, options: property.enum.map(String), type: "select" };
  }
  if (type === "boolean") {
    return { ...base, type: "boolean" };
  }
  if (type === "number" || type === "integer") {
    return { ...base, type: "number" };
  }
  if (type === "string") {
    return {
      ...base,
      type: property.format === "date" ? "date" : undefined,
    };
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * Fields from a JSON Schema, so the schema that constrains the model also
 * lays out the form. Reads `properties`, `required`, `title`, `enum`, and
 * `format: "date"`. Nested objects become dotted names. Arrays are left out.
 *
 * @example
 * const fields = generativeFormFieldsFromSchema(z.toJSONSchema(schema));
 */
export const generativeFormFieldsFromSchema = (
  schema: unknown,
  prefix = ""
): GenerativeFormField[] => {
  if (!isRecord(schema) || !isRecord(schema.properties)) {
    return [];
  }
  const required = Array.isArray(schema.required) ? schema.required : [];
  return Object.entries(schema.properties).flatMap(([key, property]) => {
    const name = `${prefix}${key}`;
    if (!isRecord(property)) {
      return [];
    }
    if (isRecord(property.properties)) {
      return generativeFormFieldsFromSchema(property, `${name}.`);
    }
    const field = schemaField(name, property, required.includes(key));
    return field ? [field] : [];
  });
};

type Draft = string | boolean;

const toDraft = (value: unknown): Draft | undefined => {
  if (typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "string") {
    return value;
  }
  return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)
    ? String(value)
    : undefined;
};

const optionOf = (
  option: string | GenerativeFormOption
): GenerativeFormOption =>
  typeof option === "string" ? { label: option, value: option } : option;

interface ResolvedField extends GenerativeFormField {
  label: string;
  type: GenerativeFormFieldType;
}

const resolveField = (
  field: GenerativeFormField,
  value: unknown
): ResolvedField => ({
  ...field,
  label: field.label ?? fieldLabel(field.name),
  type: field.type ?? (isValue(value) ? typeOfValue(value) : "text"),
});

/** The drafts as the object to submit, or the first field that blocks it. */
const collect = (
  fields: readonly ResolvedField[],
  drafts: Record<string, Draft | undefined>
): { values: Record<string, unknown> } | { problem: string; name: string } => {
  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const field of fields) {
    const draft = drafts[field.name];
    const text = typeof draft === "string" ? draft.trim() : "";
    if (field.type === "boolean") {
      writePath(values, field.name, draft === true);
    } else if (text === "") {
      if (field.required) {
        return { name: field.name, problem: `${field.label} is missing.` };
      }
    } else if (field.type === "number") {
      const parsed = Number(text.replaceAll(",", ""));
      if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        return {
          name: field.name,
          problem: `${field.label} needs to be a number.`,
        };
      }
      writePath(values, field.name, parsed);
    } else {
      writePath(values, field.name, text);
    }
  }
  return { values };
};

export interface GenerativeFormClassNames {
  root?: string;
  header?: string;
  fields?: string;
  field?: string;
  label?: string;
  control?: string;
  footer?: string;
}

export interface GenerativeFormProps {
  /** `object` from `useObject`: the structured output so far. */
  object?: object;
  /** `isLoading` from `useObject`. Fields are read-only while it is true. */
  isLoading?: boolean;
  /** `error` from `useObject`, or a message. */
  error?: Error | string;
  /** The fields to show. Left out, they are read off `object` as it arrives. */
  fields?: readonly GenerativeFormField[];
  title?: string;
  submitLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** Called with the corrected object. A returned promise holds the button. */
  onSubmit?: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => void | Promise<void>;
  /** Rendered only when passed. */
  onCancel?: () => void;
  /** `stop` from `useObject`. Rendered only when passed. */
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Rendered after an error, only when passed. */
  onRetry?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  classNames?: GenerativeFormClassNames;
  /** Handy for overriding the --generative-form-* theme vars inline */
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

const DEFAULT_OBJECT = {
  company: "Acme Inc",
  contact: "Dana Reyes",
  seats: 12,
  trial: true,
};

const APPLE_PLATFORM_RE = /Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/u;
const SKELETON_WIDTHS = ["58%", "36%", "72%", "44%"] as const;

const ENTER_CLASS =
  "fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-2 animate-in fill-mode-both duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:animate-none";

const ARRIVE_CLASS =
  "fade-in-0 animate-in duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:animate-none";

const THEME_VARS = [
  "[--generative-form-accent:#1d6496] dark:[--generative-form-accent:#6eb5dc]",
  "[--generative-form-icon-bg:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--generative-form-accent)_14%,var(--card))] dark:[--generative-form-icon-bg:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--generative-form-accent)_22%,var(--card))]",
  "[--generative-form-shadow:0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0_2px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]",
  "[--generative-form-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_2px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]",
  "dark:[--generative-form-shadow:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]",
  "dark:[--generative-form-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.13)]",
].join(" ");

const FOCUS_CLASS =
  "focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80 focus-visible:outline-none";

/** Resets the shadcn field chrome: a value reads as plain text until touched. */
const CONTROL_CLASS =
  "h-auto min-h-8 w-full min-w-0 rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-sm leading-5 text-card-foreground shadow-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70 focus-visible:border-0 motion-reduce:transition-none md:text-sm dark:bg-transparent";

const EDITABLE_CLASS =
  "hover:bg-foreground/4 focus:bg-card focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_34%,transparent),0_0_0_3px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent)] dark:focus-visible:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_42%,transparent),0_0_0_3px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent)] dark:hover:bg-foreground/4 dark:focus:bg-card";

const KBD_CLASS =
  "pointer-events-none inline-flex h-3.5 min-w-3.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-foreground/20 px-1 font-sans text-[10px] leading-none font-medium text-primary-foreground select-none";

const TEXT_ACTION_CLASS = cn(
  "flex-none cursor-pointer rounded-[4px] border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-xs leading-4 font-medium text-card-foreground hover:underline",
  FOCUS_CLASS
);

const noop = () => {
  // useSyncExternalStore never unsubscribes from this snapshot.
};

const emptySubscribe = () => noop;

const getApplePlatformSnapshot = () =>
  APPLE_PLATFORM_RE.test(navigator.userAgent);

const useIsApplePlatform = () =>
  useSyncExternalStore(emptySubscribe, getApplePlatformSnapshot, () => true);

const Icon = ({
  icon,
  className,
}: {
  icon: IconSvgElement;
  className?: string;
}) => (
  <HugeiconsIcon
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn("size-3.5 flex-none", className)}
    icon={icon}
    strokeWidth={2}
  />
);

const Shimmer = ({ children }: { children: string }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  if (reduce) {
    return <span>{children}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <motion.span
      animate={{ backgroundPosition: ["100% 0", "-100% 0"] }}
      className="bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,var(--muted-foreground)_40%,var(--card-foreground)_50%,var(--muted-foreground)_60%)] bg-[length:200%_100%] bg-clip-text text-transparent"
      transition={{
        duration: 1.8,
        ease: "linear",
        repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.span>
  );
};

const LongText = ({
  id,
  value,
  placeholder,
  invalid,
  className,
  onChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  invalid: boolean;
  className?: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) => {
  const field = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // Grows with its text where the browser does not do it on its own.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = field.current;
    if (element) {
      element.style.height = "auto";
      element.style.height = `${element.scrollHeight}px`;
    }
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <Textarea
      aria-invalid={invalid}
      className={cn(CONTROL_CLASS, EDITABLE_CLASS, "resize-none", className)}
      id={id}
      onChange={(event) => {
        onChange(event.target.value);
      }}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      ref={field}
      rows={1}
      value={value}
    />
  );
};

const FieldControl = ({
  id,
  field,
  draft,
  locked,
  invalid,
  className,
  onChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  field: ResolvedField;
  draft: Draft | undefined;
  locked: boolean;
  invalid: boolean;
  className?: string;
  onChange: (draft: Draft) => void;
}) => {
  const text = typeof draft === "string" ? draft : "";
  const options = (field.options ?? []).map(optionOf);
  const placeholder =
    field.placeholder ?? (field.required ? "Required" : "Add");

  if (field.type === "boolean") {
    return (
      <span className="flex h-8 items-center px-2">
        <Switch
          checked={draft === true}
          disabled={locked}
          id={id}
          onCheckedChange={onChange}
          size="sm"
        />
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (locked) {
    // Plain text, so nothing looks editable.
    const shown =
      options.find((option) => option.value === text)?.label ?? text;
    return (
      <div
        className={cn(
          "min-h-8 w-full min-w-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm leading-5 whitespace-pre-wrap text-card-foreground",
          className
        )}
        id={id}
      >
        {field.prefix && shown ? (
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{field.prefix}</span>
        ) : null}
        {shown}
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (field.type === "longtext") {
    return (
      <LongText
        className={className}
        id={id}
        invalid={invalid}
        onChange={onChange}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={text}
      />
    );
  }
  if (field.type === "select") {
    // A value the model made up still shows, next to the real choices.
    const items =
      options.some((option) => option.value === text) || !text
        ? options
        : [{ label: text, value: text }, ...options];
    return (
      <Select
        items={items}
        onValueChange={(next) => {
          onChange(typeof next === "string" ? next : "");
        }}
        value={text || null}
      >
        <SelectTrigger
          aria-invalid={invalid}
          className={cn(
            CONTROL_CLASS,
            EDITABLE_CLASS,
            "cursor-pointer data-[popup-open]:bg-muted dark:data-[popup-open]:bg-background [&_svg]:size-3.5",
            className
          )}
          id={id}
          size="sm"
        >
          <SelectValue placeholder={placeholder} />
        </SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent align="start" alignItemWithTrigger={false}>
          {items.map((option) => (
            <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
              {option.label}
            </SelectItem>
          ))}
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "flex min-w-0 items-center rounded-md transition-colors duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
        field.prefix &&
          "focus-within:bg-card focus-within:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_34%,transparent),0_0_0_3px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_8%,transparent)] hover:bg-foreground/4 dark:focus-within:bg-card dark:focus-within:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_42%,transparent),0_0_0_3px_color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_12%,transparent)]"
      )}
    >
      {field.prefix ? (
        <span className="pl-2 text-sm leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
          {field.prefix}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <Input
        aria-invalid={invalid}
        className={cn(
          CONTROL_CLASS,
          field.prefix
            ? "pl-0 focus-visible:ring-0 dark:bg-transparent"
            : EDITABLE_CLASS,
          field.type === "number" && "tabular-nums",
          className
        )}
        id={id}
        inputMode={field.type === "number" ? "decimal" : undefined}
        onChange={(event) => {
          onChange(event.target.value);
        }}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        type={field.type === "date" ? "date" : "text"}
        value={text}
      />
    </span>
  );
};

const errorText = (error: Error | string | undefined): string | null => {
  if (!error) {
    return null;
  }
  const message = typeof error === "string" ? error : error.message;
  return message || "The form could not be filled in.";
};

/**
 * A form that fills itself in from a streaming structured object, then hands
 * the result to the user to correct and send.
 *
 * @example
 * const { object, isLoading, error, submit, stop } = useObject({
 *   api: "/api/extract",
 *   schema,
 * });
 *
 * <GenerativeForm
 *   error={error}
 *   fields={generativeFormFieldsFromSchema(z.toJSONSchema(schema))}
 *   isLoading={isLoading}
 *   object={object}
 *   onStop={stop}
 *   onSubmit={(values) => save(schema.parse(values))}
 * />
 */
export const GenerativeForm = ({
  object = DEFAULT_OBJECT,
  isLoading = false,
  error,
  fields,
  title = "Review details",
  submitLabel = "Submit",
  cancelLabel = "Discard",
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
  onStop,
  onRetry,
  className,
  classNames,
  style,
}: GenerativeFormProps) => {
  const formId = useId();
  const isApple = useIsApplePlatform();
  const [edits, setEdits] = useState<Record<string, Draft>>({});
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<{ name: string; text: string } | null>(
    null
  );
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  // A new stream replaces what the user typed over the last one.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading) {
      setEdits({});
      setProblem(null);
    }
  }, [isLoading]);

  const resolved = (fields ?? generativeFormFields(object)).map((field) =>
    resolveField(field, readPath(object, field.name))
  );
  const drafts: Record<string, Draft | undefined> = {};
  for (const field of resolved) {
    drafts[field.name] =
      edits[field.name] ?? toDraft(readPath(object, field.name));
  }
  const edited = Object.keys(edits).length;
  const failure = errorText(error);
  const idFor = (name: string) => `${formId}-${name}`;

  const submit = async (event?: FormEvent) => {
    event?.preventDefault();
    if (isLoading || sending || !onSubmit) {
      return;
    }
    const result = collect(resolved, drafts);
    if ("problem" in result) {
      setProblem({ name: result.name, text: result.problem });
      root.current
        ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${CSS.escape(idFor(result.name))}`)
        ?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setProblem(null);
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(result.values);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form
      aria-busy={isLoading}
      aria-label={title}
      className={cn(
        THEME_VARS,
        "@container/generative-form flex w-full max-w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground shadow-(--generative-form-shadow) transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-(--generative-form-shadow-hover)",
        className,
        classNames?.root
      )}
      data-slot="generative-form"
      data-state={isLoading ? "streaming" : "ready"}
      noValidate
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
          void submit();
        }
      }}
      onSubmit={submit}
      ref={root}
      style={style}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2",
          classNames?.header
        )}
        data-slot="generative-form-header"
      >
        <span className="inline-flex size-6 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-(--generative-form-icon-bg)">
          <Icon
            className="text-(--generative-form-accent)"
            icon={NoteEditIcon}
          />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-[13px] leading-tight font-medium tracking-[-0.01em]">
          {title}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex flex-col gap-0.5 delay-100",
          classNames?.fields
        )}
        data-slot="generative-form-fields"
      >
        {resolved.map((field, index) => {
          const draft = drafts[field.name];
          const waiting = isLoading && draft === undefined;
          return (
            <div
              className={cn(
                "grid min-w-0 grid-cols-1 items-start gap-x-3 @sm/generative-form:grid-cols-[7rem_minmax(0,1fr)]",
                classNames?.field
              )}
              data-slot="generative-form-field"
              key={field.name}
            >
              <label
                className={cn(
                  "flex min-h-6 items-center gap-1.5 px-2 pt-1 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground @sm/generative-form:min-h-8 @sm/generative-form:px-0.5 @sm/generative-form:pt-0 @sm/generative-form:text-[13px]",
                  classNames?.label
                )}
                htmlFor={idFor(field.name)}
              >
                <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{field.label}</span>
                {field.name in edits ? (
                  <span
                    className="size-1 flex-none rounded-full bg-primary"
                    title="Edited"
                  >
                    <span className="sr-only">Edited</span>
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </label>
              {waiting ? (
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex h-8 items-center px-2">
                  <span
                    className="h-2.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-foreground/6 motion-reduce:animate-none"
                    style={{
                      width: SKELETON_WIDTHS[index % SKELETON_WIDTHS.length],
                    }}
                  />
                </span>
              ) : (
                <div className={cn(ARRIVE_CLASS, "min-w-0")}>
                  <FieldControl
                    className={classNames?.control}
                    draft={draft}
                    field={field}
                    id={idFor(field.name)}
                    invalid={problem?.name === field.name}
                    locked={isLoading}
                    onChange={(next) => {
                      setEdits((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        [field.name]: next,
                      }));
                      if (problem?.name === field.name) {
                        setProblem(null);
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {resolved.length === 0 ? (
          <div aria-hidden="true" className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
            {SKELETON_WIDTHS.map((width) => (
              <span className="flex h-8 items-center px-0.5" key={width}>
                <span
                  className="h-2.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-foreground/6 motion-reduce:animate-none"
                  style={{ width }}
                />
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex min-h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 delay-200",
          classNames?.footer
        )}
        data-slot="generative-form-footer"
      >
        <output
          aria-live="polite"
          className={cn(
            "flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5 pl-0.5 text-xs leading-4",
            failure || problem ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"
          )}
          data-slot="generative-form-status"
        >
          {isLoading ? <Shimmer>Filling in…</Shimmer> : null}
          {!isLoading && failure ? (
            <>
              <Icon icon={AlertCircleIcon} />
              <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{failure}</span>
            </>
          ) : null}
          {!isLoading && !failure && problem ? (
            <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{problem.text}</span>
          ) : null}
          {!isLoading && !failure && !problem && edited > 0 ? (
            <>
              <span className="min-w-0 truncate tabular-nums">
                {edited} edited
              </span>
              <button
                className={TEXT_ACTION_CLASS}
                data-slot="generative-form-reset"
                onClick={() => {
                  setEdits({});
                }}
                type="button"
              >
                Reset
              </button>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </output>
        <div className="flex flex-none items-center gap-1.5">
          {isLoading && onStop ? (
            <Button
              className="rounded-full px-2.5"
              size="xs"
              variant="secondary"
              data-slot="generative-form-stop"
              onClick={onStop}
              type="button"
            >
              Stop
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          {!isLoading && failure && onRetry ? (
            <Button
              className="rounded-full px-2.5"
              size="xs"
              variant="secondary"
              data-slot="generative-form-retry"
              onClick={onRetry}
              type="button"
            >
              Retry
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          {!isLoading && onCancel ? (
            <Button
              className="rounded-full px-2.5"
              size="xs"
              variant="secondary"
              data-slot="generative-form-cancel"
              disabled={sending}
              onClick={onCancel}
              type="button"
            >
              {cancelLabel}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          {!isLoading && onSubmit ? (
            <Button
              aria-keyshortcuts={isApple ? "Meta+Enter" : "Control+Enter"}
              className="rounded-full px-2.5 pr-1.5"
              size="xs"
              variant="default"
              data-slot="generative-form-submit"
              disabled={sending || resolved.length === 0}
              type="submit"
            >
              {submitLabel}
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="inline-flex gap-0.5">
                <kbd className={KBD_CLASS}>{isApple ? "⌘" : "Ctrl"}</kbd>
                <kbd className={KBD_CLASS}>↵</kbd>
              </span>
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};
